theorem repro_piAtL (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    ∃ π : (baseChangeBundle C L).left ⟶ P1 L,
      IsFinite π ∧ IsDominant π ∧ π ≫ P1.structureMap L = (baseChangeBundle C L).hom := by

    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionSndLeft C L
  haveI : IsProper (baseChangeBundle C L).hom := instIsProperSndLeft C L
  haveI : GeometricallyIrreducible (baseChangeBundle C L).hom :=
    instGeometricallyIrreducibleSndLeft C L
  exact exists_isFinite_isDominant_toP1 (baseChangeBundle C L)

-- REPRO 2: is windowA_choice's bound <= mine, i.e. is the landed lemma STRONGER?
theorem repro_windowA_le_windowM {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : ℕ) :
    (windowA_choice π hπ : ℤ) * windowδ π
      ≤ (windowM_choice π hπ g : ℤ) * windowδ π := by
  have hle : windowA_choice π hπ ≤ windowM_choice π hπ g :=
    Nat.find_le (windowBound_le_M_mul π hπ g)
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hle) (windowδ_nonneg π)

end AlgebraicGeometry

*proposition* already exist". Only a statement-level search (`leansearch`/`loogle` on the
mathematical content) can see the same fact under another name.

proof happens to use. Before claiming "no such object exists", census *producers*
